model: RandomForestClassifier (500 trees, random_state=42) with median imputation of zero-coded missing values
notes: Stratified 80/20 split (random_state=42). followup_score was excluded because it is a post-diagnosis measurement that nearly separates the classes (r=0.83), which would leak the outcome; including it gives 0.927 test accuracy but is not a valid predictor for new patients.
